elements.label: Figure 6.10
elements.description: Grouped bar chart. Y-axis: "Share of respondents (%)", scale 0 to 50 in steps of 10. X-axis categories: "Has an account", "Has a debit card", "Has a credit card". Legend: 2017 (teal), 2019 (orange). Values printed: Has an account – 2017: 26.4, 2019: 42.3; Has a debit card – 2017: 24.0, 2019: no bar shown; Has a credit card – 2017: 3.9, 2019: 3.2. Source: Based on 2017 data from the Global Findex database and World Bank 2019. Notes: The FINDEX target population is the population of individuals aged 15 years and older. Pattern: account ownership rose from 2017 to 2019, while credit card ownership slipped slightly; debit card data exist only for 2017.

elements.label: Figure 6.11
elements.description: Bar chart. Y-axis: "Share of respondents (%)", scale 0 to 80 in steps of 10. X-axis categories: "From a financial institution", "From family or friends", "From an informal savings club". Legend: 2017 (teal). Values printed: From a financial institution – 42.0; From family or friends – 60.2; From an informal savings club – 48.4. Source: Based on 2017 data from the Global Findex database. Notes: The FINDEX target population is the population of individuals aged 15 years and older. Pattern: borrowing from family or friends is the highest share, followed by informal savings clubs, then financial institutions.
